lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The Royal Post Office. They say the mail always gets through. They do not say WHEN.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Why are we here?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The Dead Letter King has been hoarding every heartfelt letter in history. The kingdom's feelings are BACKED UP, hero. It's an emotional plumbing emergency.

lines.speaker: Postmaster
lines.text: FOUR BILLION AND TWELVE. That is how many letters I have rejected. Yours would be four billion and THIRTEEN.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: We didn't bring a letter.

lines.speaker: Postmaster
lines.text: THEN I SHALL REJECT YOU DIRECTLY.
A throne room of pigeonholes, each one glowing faintly with an unread letter.

lines.speaker: Dead Letter King
lines.text: Every unsaid apology. Every unmailed confession. MINE. They are safest unread. Unread words... cannot wound.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: They can't HEAL either, your majesty.

lines.speaker: Dead Letter King
lines.text: ...deliver THIS, then.

lines.speaker: Dead Letter King
lines.text: Very well... release the mail... ALL of it...
A century of letters takes flight at once, darkening the sky like starlings. Somewhere, ten thousand grudges end.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Hero. There's one for you. It's from the slimes. It says "good hustle". I'm crying.
A sorting tray rattles. One letter has worked itself loose. The address, in careful goo-print: TO THE HERO. THE MEADOW. YOU KNOW THE ONE.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: It's from the slimes, hero. It's been in the system since chapter one. It's trying to REACH you.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: ...we get that letter out of here. Whatever it takes.

lines.speaker: The Chain Letter
lines.text: FORWARD ME TO TEN FRIENDS OR SUFFER MISFORTUNE. YOUR GRANDMOTHER FORWARDED ME. YOUR KING FORWARDED ME. BE LIKE THEM.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: I have five friends and they're all in this party.

lines.speaker: The Chain Letter
lines.text: THEN THE MISFORTUNE IS DOUBLED AND SHARED. HOW EFFICIENT.
The antechamber of the Dead Letter King. Millions of pigeonholes. In each: an apology, a confession, a birthday card with the money still inside.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Every unsaid thing in the kingdom, hero. Filed. Hoarded. He thinks he's protecting people.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Words don't expire. Let's go deliver them.
